note: Missouri Department of Conservation access on the Loutre River: 163 acres of bottomland forest and old fields with a canoe launch. MDC's map marks one primitive camping area beside the gravel access road just above the small gravel lot at the launch; no facilities. Reached by Graveyard Hill Road (County Road 278) south off Route N west of Mineola. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one map-designated primitive camping area beside the gravel road at the canoe-launch lot (GIS 373). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin moves ~50 m out of woods onto the lot. Phone matches; not waterfront kept. No brochure on the page.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; the 2008 area map's legend has 'Primitive Camping Area' and places one symbol beside the gravel access road just north of the parking lot at the 'Canoe Launch Area'; GIS 27 point 373 'Loutre Lick Access Primitive Camping Area'. Rule 140 is the standard text; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101. The page links no brochure.

PIN (move ~50 m): stored 38.88164,-91.58036 = GIS point 373, which imagery shows under forest canopy ~15 m east of the gravel road. Move to the gravel lot at the end of the road, 38.8812,-91.5805 (GIS 26 lot 204, 51 m). Map shows the access as 'Gravel Road' from CR 278; imagery shows a wide gravel lane ending in a small (~20 m) gravel turnaround - tight but drivable for a 23-ft rig; no low-water crossing or posted limit.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The lot sits ~25-30 m from the top of the Loutre River bank and ~45 m from the water (channel ~30 m wide), but the ground between is a wooded bank, not an open apron; no official photo shows the river from the camping spot, so no view value is earned.
HORSES: none listed. CLUSTERS: a single spot.
PHONE: 'For more information call (573) 815-7900' matches stored.
NOTE: rewritten; dropped the 14-day limit (booking.max_stay_nights), 'Site length not published' and the boilerplate inclusion sentence.
